capabilities.text: Draw a molecule with one central atom, chosen by its formula
capabilities.note: Ours picks from nine set molecules (BeCl₂, BF₃, CH₄, NH₃, H₂O, PCl₅, SF₆, XeF₄, SF₄); typing any formula is cap-01b.

capabilities.text: Type any formula of main-group elements through period 5 with one central atom
capabilities.note: Ours has no typed formula; shapes such as T-shaped, square pyramidal and AX₂E₃ linear are not reachable.

capabilities.text: Draw a polyatomic ion, with its charge
Choose wedge-and-dash or ball-and-stick
capabilities.note: Ours always draws a flat ball-and-stick model (checked by render); no wedge-and-dash and no choice. The reference’s Style is a radio defaulting to wedge-and-dash, so this is a choice, not an always-drawn feature; left open.

capabilities.text: Draw the balls in color or grayscale
capabilities.note: Print fills the balls with patterns rather than grays.

capabilities.text: Show or hide the atom symbols on the balls
Turn the view any way from the textbook view
capabilities.note: Ours turns by typed yaw and pitch.

capabilities.text: Drag the figure to turn it
capabilities.note: Ours has no handles on this figure.

capabilities.text: Draw the central atom’s lone pairs as lobes
capabilities.note: Ours draws lone pairs as dots only.

capabilities.text: Draw the central atom’s lone pairs as dots
capabilities.note: Checked by hand: NH₃ shows its lone pair as two dots.

capabilities.text: Hide the central atom’s lone pairs
capabilities.note: Token passes on the molecule alone; checked by hand that hiding changes the NH₃ render.
